# Valuation Multiples

Each name's multiples today, its own range over up to ten years of month-end prices, and the median of its SEC industry (SIC) peers among captured names. Use it to test exit multiples: an exit multiple above the name's own 75th percentile or its peer median needs a stated reason.

Point in time: each month uses the as-traded close and SEC facts filed by the month's last day, split-adjusted where a split falls between the filing and the month end. P/E is price over trailing GAAP net income per diluted share, so companies whose guidance is on an adjusted basis read higher here. EV is market value plus long-term debt less cash and short-term investments; leases and preferred stock are excluded. Multiples above 1,000x or on negative earnings are blank. Monthly history: `data/multiples/<T>.csv`; detail for one name: `python3 -m capital.multiples TICKER`. For banks and insurers EV multiples are not meaningful (deposits and policy liabilities are operating funding); use P/E and book value.
